summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Braiin Ltd to report a three-for-one forward stock split announced April 29, 2026, effective after market close April 28, 2026. Shareholders of record April 27 received two additional shares per share held. The split reduces per-share trading price to broaden retail investor access and does not change market cap or proportional ownership. Board approved April 9; shareholders approved at extraordinary meeting April 10. No acquisition, divestiture, or special situation beyond a routine capital adjustment. No terms apply.
